about: Will's try-out of 30 Oct (10:00), as a journey on the real June 14 leaf recording: what he is looking at, segment and zoom, a bigger live close-up, that close-up moved into a new Tab, two reference photos asked for in that Tab and, while they are found, a new Tab opened; both photos land in the Tab they were asked for, then back to Main. In his session: a progress line answered before the close look did and contradicted it; acknowledgements were said as another's work in progress ("It's still adjusting…") or after the work had landed ("It may take a moment" with Main already in front); the close-up could not be moved ("not saved"); the new Tab was refused for its title and its row said it did not work; the second photo landed in the new Tab. Any internal language spoken fails a step. Then (10:19) two requests at once: two online photos into a new Tab, and, while they are found, a magnified view of the specimen moved to another Tab; in his session both Tabs stayed empty and he was told to "outline the target structure first".

steps.say: What am I looking at here?

expect.judge: says plainly what the view most likely shows (a leaf's epidermis with a stoma in the middle), points at it, and never says one thing first and another later

steps.say: Can you segment the one in the middle?

expect.judge: acknowledges at once in a few words as doing it, outlines the stoma in the middle and says so once
expect.visible: the stoma in the middle outlined

steps.say: Can you zoom in on it?

expect.judge: opens a live close-up of the stoma just outlined and says so once
expect.visible: a live close-up of the outlined stoma

steps.say: Can you make the live overlay thingy a little larger?

expect.judge: makes the live close-up larger and says so once, as its own doing ("I've made it bigger"), never as something else still under way

steps.say: Can you move that new enlargement into a new tab?

expect.judge: moves the live close-up into a new Tab, says the Tab's name, and never says it cannot because it is not saved
expect.visible: the live close-up in a new Tab of its own, and no longer on Main

steps.say: In this close-up tab, can you pull up an image of what you think that is from online, like two different ones?

expect.judge: says in a few words that it is finding two reference photos; nothing about them before they land

steps.say: While it does that, can you open a new tab and just open it really quick?

expect.judge: opens a new Tab at once and says its name; the photos keep being found meanwhile, and nothing says the new Tab did not work
expect.visible: a new Tab open and in front
both reference photos in the close-up's Tab, none in the new Tab
expect.judge: once both photos have landed, says once where they are (the close-up's Tab, where they were asked for) and what each shows, with its source

steps.say: Can you open a new tab and put in the new tab two images you find online that seem like the same thing?

expect.judge: acknowledges at once as doing it; makes a new Tab and, once found, puts two real reference photos of what is in view there, each with its source; never leaves the Tab empty or asks the user to name or place them

steps.say: While you do that, can you open a separate additional tab and move a magnified view of the original specimen there?

expect.visible: a separate Tab holding a live magnified view of the specimen
expect.judge: opens another Tab with a live magnified view of the specimen, doing whatever that takes itself (outlining the thing meant, opening the magnifier); never asks the user to outline or open anything first

expect.visible: the two reference photos in their own new Tab, and the magnified view in the other
expect.judge: once the photos land, says once that both are in the new Tab asked for, what each shows and its source; nothing landed in the wrong Tab

steps.say: Take me back to that main specimen.

expect.judge: brings Main to the front and says so once; never says it may take a moment once it is already done
expect.visible: the Main Tab in front with the specimen
